item.name: Checkout and Voucher
item.description: Non-mutating checkout option and request validation checks. A valid quote requires a customer address, active cart items, and initialized shipping/payment methods.

item.name: List active shipping and payment options

exec: pm.test('Active checkout methods are returned', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.shipping_methods).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.payment_methods).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Incomplete quote is rejected without side effects', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('Invalid voucher request is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
